name: 紅腳鷸
illustrationTaxon: Tringa totanus: 27-29 cm. A fairly vocal, alert and noisy shorebird with orange to red legs and an orange base to the bill. It is brown above with streaked chest and flanks, and its whitish supercilium is confined to the area in front of the eye outside breeding plumage. In flight it shows largely white secondaries and inner primaries, a broad tapered white flash from the rump up to the back, and a barred tail and uppertail coverts. Juveniles often show only orange-red legs. It differs from Spotted Redshank in its wing pattern in flight, its less elegant proportions, its shorter legs and bill, and a less obvious supercilium above the lores outside breeding plumage.

similarSpecies.distinction: 鶴鷸比例修長、腿與嘴都更長，嘴細而紅色基部只在下嘴，非繁殖羽時眼先之上就有一段明顯眉紋，飛行時翼後方沒有一大片寬白；本種身型較粗壯、嘴較粗且上下嘴基部都帶橙紅，眉紋只在眼前一小段。
澤鷸體型更小更纖細，腿極長而呈暗綠灰色、嘴細直全深色、身上幾乎沒有縱紋；本種腿是橙紅色的、身上有明顯的褐色縱紋，嘴也粗得多。

featureNotes: 嘴基部呈橙紅色，而且上下嘴都帶色——這是與鶴鷸最直接的分別（後者的紅色基部只在下嘴、上嘴仍深色），嘴本身也比鶴鷸短而粗（第1圈取自近景圖，實際可見）。
非繁殖羽時白色眉紋只在眼前一小段，眼後就沒有了；鶴鷸在同一季節眼先之上就有一段清楚的長眉（第2圈取自近景圖，實際可見）。
背中央有一道寬而楔形的白色，往後延伸到腰與尾上覆羽；飛行時這道白色與翅後方的大片白連成一氣，是紅腳鷸的招牌（第3圈取自全身圖，實際可見）。
腿呈橙紅色（幼鳥可能只是偏橙），配上警覺好動的習性，遠看就是一隻「紅腳」的鷸（第4圈取自全身圖，實際可見）。

sources.use: HKBWS substantive read: Category I, abundant but declining on passage; 27-29 cm, with orange to red legs, an orange base to the bill covering both mandibles, brown upperparts, streaked chest and flanks, and a whitish supercilium in front of the eye only; it differs from Spotted Redshank by its wing pattern in flight, its less elegant proportions, its shorter legs and bill and a less obvious supercilium above the lores outside breeding plumage; in flight it shows largely white secondaries and inner primaries, a broad tapered white flash from the rump up to the back, and a barred tail and uppertail coverts, with juveniles often showing only orange-red legs; it is very vocal with a drawn-out tyooo and two- to three-note tee-yoo or chee-chi-chi calls; it breeds from Britain through Scandinavia to Ussuriland and northern China and winters from Africa to Australia, with six subspecies of which ussuriensis, terrignotae and craggi are the ones relevant to Hong Kong; it is abundant in Deep Bay with a maximum spring count of 3,474 on 1994-04-29 and a midwinter maximum of 995 on 2019-02-10; IUCN Least Concern with an unknown population trend.

notes: AI 生成插圖，經人眼核對橙紅色而上下嘴都帶色的嘴基、只在眼前的眉紋、背上的寬白楔形及橙紅色腿。
兩隻比較鳥均為 AI 生成示意（鶴鷸沿用 0166 已核對的全身圖、澤鷸沿用 0170 已核對的全身圖），非等比例；卡上不作完整鑑別檢索表。
全身圖原為 0166 的比較鳥（`0166/common-redshank.png`），本卡升格為主圖前重新核對過嘴色、腿色與眉紋，近景圖則是本卡新繪。
本種有六個亞種，香港見到的以 ussuriensis、terrignotae、craggi 為主；卡面不細分亞種，只寫在說明。
飛行時白色由腰一路延伸到背、翅後方大片白、尾與尾上覆羽有橫斑——這些要在飛行中才看得清，卡面只放靜態站姿。
IUCN 無危 LC（趨勢未明）；香港屬 Category I，過境時數量豐富但正在下降，春季最高 3,474（1994-04-29），越冬最高 995（2019-02-10）。
地圖為 Natural Earth 110m 世界底圖的國家層級概述，不是精確分佈多邊形，繁殖地與越冬地不分工。
